models.name: OpenTimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request for opening an observable conversation timeline view.

fields.name: conversationId
fields.description: Conversation id to observe.

fields.name: messageLimit
fields.description: Maximum messages to include in the initial snapshot.

models.name: OpenConversationListViewRequest
models.description: Request for opening an observable conversation list view.

fields.name: conversationLimit
fields.description: Maximum conversations to include in the initial snapshot.

models.name: LoadOlderTimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request for extending an open timeline view with older messages.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Timeline view id returned from openTimeline.

fields.name: messageLimit
fields.description: Maximum older messages to load in this page.

models.name: CloseViewRequest
models.description: Request for closing an observable view.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: View id returned from an open view call.

models.name: ViewSnapshot
models.description: Tagged snapshot emitted by core observable views.

fields.name: viewType
fields.description: Snapshot tag: timeline or conversationList.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Snapshot payload selected by viewType.

models.name: ViewOpenResponse
models.description: Response returned when opening an observable view.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Opened view id.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Initial snapshot for this view.

models.name: ViewDeltaOp
models.description: One operation in an observable view delta.

fields.name: op
fields.description: Delta operation: insert, update, remove, or move.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable item key owned by core.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Target index after applying the operation.

fields.name: fromIndex
fields.description: Previous index for move operations.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Inserted or updated item payload.

models.name: ViewDelta
models.description: Typed delta emitted by core observable views.

fields.name: viewType
fields.description: Delta tag: timeline or conversationList.

fields.name: ops
fields.description: Ordered delta operations.

fields.name: conversation
fields.description: Latest timeline conversation header for timeline deltas.

fields.name: hasMore
fields.description: Latest timeline pagination state for timeline deltas.

fields.name: totalUnread
fields.description: Latest total unread value for conversation list deltas.

fields.name: syncState
fields.description: Latest sync state for conversation list deltas.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Updated view id.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Update kind: snapshot or delta.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Latest snapshot for this view when kind is snapshot.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: View delta when kind is delta.

models.name: ViewLoadOlderResponse
models.description: Response returned after extending an observable timeline view.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Updated timeline view id.

fields.name: loadedCount
fields.description: Number of older messages inserted into the view window.

fields.name: hasMore
fields.description: Whether older messages may still be available.

fields.name: update
fields.description: Delta or snapshot that applies this page to the view.

models.name: CloseViewResponse
models.description: Response returned when closing an observable view.

fields.name: closed
fields.description: Whether a view registration was closed.
